Before posting, read the security policy (`SECURITY.md` in this checkout). Do not include vulnerabilities, credentials, endpoint secrets, private task contents, authentication files or raw databases. There is no verified private security-reporting channel yet.

### Version and platform

- Source commit/tag, or local archive version and checksum:
- macOS version and architecture (or platform for a source-only reproduction):
- Node version; coding app/version if relevant:
- Workflow mode and entry point (fake demo, legacy overnight, coding core or portable beta):

### Expected and actual behavior

What should happen, and what happened instead? Include the exact safe command or UI action and any bounded error message.

### Minimal reproduction

Provide numbered steps using a disposable repository and synthetic data. Identify required local inputs. Remove personal paths, account identifiers and provider URLs when they are not needed to reproduce the problem.

### Evidence and limits

Include a short redacted excerpt or check summary, with the command, exit status and relevant phase. Say whether this used fake responses, a loopback fixture, an actual app or a real model. Describe any retained/uncertain owner or interrupted maintenance; do not clear holds or delete state to simplify the report. Keep complete logs and databases private.
